title: Claude Ultra free for 6 months
desc: Anthropic's Claude for Open Source program: 6 months of Claude Ultra for open-source maintainers and contributors. Apply on the official page.
note: Only for qualifying open-source maintainers and contributors. You apply; places are limited.

title: audio.cpp: free local AI audio
desc: Clone voices, make music and transcribe speech on your own computer. Free, open source, Windows, Mac and Linux.
note: Each model keeps its own licence. Some are non-commercial.

title: FreeLLMAPI: 10B free AI tokens a month
desc: Stack the free tiers of 87 AI providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Free, open source, runs on your machine.
note: For personal projects, not production. You add your own free provider keys.

title: Upscayl: free AI photo upscaler
desc: Turn small, pixelated photos sharp at 4x the size. Free, open source, runs offline on Windows, Mac and Linux.
note: Needs a graphics card with Vulkan support.
